items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT on ETR Sunday fantasy injuries board alongside Tank Bigsby, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown.
items.why: Final injury report designation after hamstring issue; no practice.
items.implication: Eagles backfield thins significantly with Bigsby also out.
items.opportunity: Lead role opens for remaining backs like Shipley/Pierce; Hurts may see more designed runs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT on ETR board.
items.why: Ankle injury; confirmed ruled out by coach/insiders.
items.implication: Ravens offense shifts without dual-threat QB.
items.opportunity: Increased reliance on run game/Henry and TEs/WRs in shorter areas; Flowers Q status key.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN on ETR Sunday injuries; off final report after limited practices.
items.why: Full participant Friday; ankle maintenance only per coach/player.
items.implication: Expected to play vs Lions with potential expanded role.
items.opportunity: Workload upgrade projected; clear of Allgeier.

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN; will start.
items.why: Cleared and starting vs Giants; Diggs OUT.
items.implication: Commanders offense upgrades with dual-threat QB return.
items.opportunity: Boosts pass catchers; Diggs absence elevates others.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT on ETR board with Barkley/Hollywood.
items.implication: Eagles WR room depleted; Goedert IN.
Commanders WR targets redistribute with Daniels back.
LAC WR depth thins; McConkey Q.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love tough projection spot but not on final IR; gut says much better role this week after Week 4 usage drag. Currently 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Accounts for ankle maintenance downside.
items.why: Fan/media pressure on prior usage + full practice; player says full-go.
items.implication: RB2 upside vs Lions if role expands as projected.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry/route share expected; clear lead.
items.conflict: Downside if ankle limits or shares more.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs soft pass D.
items.why: Target hog + matchup gift; high volume.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + Bengals injuries potential + soft run D. Gobbles targets/fantasy points.
items.why: Volume + matchup; Chase/Higgins Q boosts passing game involvement.
items.opportunity: High carries + targets if WRs limited.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: knee becomes issue, can't shake shoulder, QB change to McCarthy, coaching boomer style. Frustrated over lack of targets post-halftime.
items.why: Sore knee missed practice + known shoulder + scheme/QB concerns.
items.implication: Elevated injury/role volatility ROS despite talent.
items.conflict: Talent still elite if healthy/scheme fits.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41); tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
items.why: Usage numbers + matchup + injury concern (Q with Jefferson).
